subject: Private node-group patch window — tactical checklist & rollback lane
messages:
From: Anita Reddy <anita@finxbank.com>

Cc: FinX Ops <ops@finxbank.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: private node-group patch window + pinning/rollback details

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the earlier conversation. We need to schedule a maintenance window to apply a critical security patch to our Private deployment (VPC, node-group alpha-1) and to pin to a compatible Redwood runtime/model variant while we validate. Compliance needs a clear rollback lane, audit logs, and a canary plan.

Proposed window: Thu Aug 27, 00:00–04:00 UTC (preferred)
Primary asks from our side:
- Confirm a pinned image/tag we can lock to for the window and how long the pin will be enforced.
- Exact rollback procedure (steps + estimated RTO).
- What telemetry/metrics you want us to watch during canary and full rollout.
- Evidence artifacts for our security team (post-patch audit logs, kernel/quantization change notes).

We have a procurement note that any patch requiring >30m of degraded capacity needs exec approval; we'll surface that after we see the plan.

Can you send a concise tactical checklist and the runbook you plan to execute? Attachments preferred as PDF/Docx.

Thanks —
Anita Reddy
Director, Infrastructure Security, FinX Bank
Anita.Reddy@finxbank.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Reddy <anita@finxbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private node-group patch window + pinning/rollback details

Hi Anita —

Thanks — we can run the patch in your proposed window. Attached is a concise tactical checklist (PDF) and the draft playbook. Key points up-front:

- Pin: We'll publish a pin tag: redwood-runtime:2026-06-11-pin1 (we recommend keeping the pin for 72h and automatically unpin after ops signoff).
- Canary: 5% of traffic to the canary node-group for 30 minutes; health metrics guardrails below.
- Rollback: Immediate network-level traffic shift back to pre-patch snapshot + runtime revert. Estimated RTO: 9–12 minutes if triggers are clear.
- KV cache: We'll coordinate a staged KV cache flush on canary only; full flush only if canary succeeds.
- Snapshots: Take VM and application snapshots at T-20 minutes.
- Audit: We will save patch logs, kernel selection notes, and the model quantization checksum in the drive link and hand off an evidence pack.

Please find attachments: redwood_private_patch_playbook_v1.pdf, canary-metrics-checklist.xlsx, finx_pinning_agreement_20260813.docx (draft).

Internal action items for @karthik, @monica, @neha: please confirm the rollback commands below, validate the canary metric thresholds (latency, error-rate, cpu), and confirm on-call coverage for the window.

Mina Haddad
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: private node-group patch window + pinning/rollback details

On Thu, Aug 13, 2026 at 09:35 Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Please find attachments: redwood_private_patch_playbook_v1.pdf, canary-metrics-checklist.xlsx, finx_pinning_agreement_20260813.docx (draft).

Quick engineering confirmation and additions:

- Rollback commands (short):
  1) Disable new routing policy (route: canary->alpha-1) and reapply pre-patch routing table.
  2) Trigger orchestration: redwoodctl rollback --group alpha-1 --to-tag redwood-runtime:2026-05-02-stable
  3) Rehydrate KV from snapshot (redis-snap-20260813T08z) for 0/5 nodes then scale full.
  4) Re-open traffic progressively, watch per-node 95p latency and 5m error rate.

- Guardrails / triggers (suggested):
  • 95p latency increase >40% vs baseline over 5m -> AUTO-PAUSE and escalate.
  • Error rate >1.0% sustained for 5m -> rollback.
  • Queue length >2500 pending requests for 2m -> rollback.

- Expected RTO math: orchestration + traffic shift ~ 6–9 min, KV rehydrate worst-case ~ 12–18 min if full rehydrate required; hence the 9–12 min average we gave is conservative.

- Additional ask for FinX side: please approve a 30-minute warm-up reserve (2x baseline) for LB to avoid cold-start amplification.

I'll update the playbook with explicit redwoodctl snippets and a short checklist for NOC. Link to draft runbook in related_links.

— Karthik
Lead, Serving Runtime Integrations
Redwood Inference
